title: Courtesy Credit Record over 24 Months: Returned-Fee Courtesy Addition for the Crestline Credit Card
content:
Northgate's returned-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card recognizes an account that has not leaned on courtesy credits: when no courtesy credit of any kind was posted to the account fewer than 24 whole months before today, 0.1 is added to the share of the returned payment fee that the courtesy credit returns; when none was posted fewer than 12 whole months before today but one was posted fewer than 24, 0.05 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The share, with every addition made to it, never exceeds 1.0 — the whole fee.

**Records read:** fee reversals on the card ledger for the reason courtesy waiver — on late fees and on returned payment fees alike — and their posting dates.

| Most recent courtesy credit posted | Added |
|---|---|
| none fewer than 24 whole months before today | 0.1 |
| none fewer than 12 whole months before today, one fewer than 24 | 0.05 |
| one fewer than 12 whole months before today | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Last courtesy credit 25 months ago: 0.1. Last courtesy credit 18 months ago: 0.05. Last courtesy credit 7 months ago: nothing.
- A billing-error reversal 3 months ago is not a courtesy credit and does not count.
